fieldStoreProvenance.note: Generated on the spot by the bound ControlServer commit on the synthetic rig: a synthetic onboard peer and the fake RIoT, not a real vehicle and not the real RIoT. Weaker than a field store in two ways (control-server#453): the state was not written by a real demand on a real vehicle; and it was written by the build under test in its own schema, so restoring it migrates nothing -- the restart and side-effect assertions no longer also show that a store another build wrote, in an older schema, is taken over. Its protocolCommit is asserted inside protocolAndBuildIdentityBoundToTheSharedBinding, where it holds by construction: it can only show the store was written by this build, not catch a product regression.
